newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merit Medical cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merit Medical cut to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said it cut Merit Medical Systems Inc to a hold from a buy, and lowered its fiscal 1997 estimate to $0.41 a share from $0.50, compared with $0.32 a year ago.
-- Merit Medical recently reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.07 a share, even with a year ago, but below Dain's estimate of $0.10. Earnings were in line with recent guidance, it added.
-- Dain said it cut its fiscal 1997 estimate primarily due to an expected increase in costs.
-- Merit Medical shares were off 3/4 at 7-3/4.
